sloka: यदि दृष्टा त्वया सीता जम्बो जांबूनद सम प्रभा ।प्रियाम् यदि विजानासि निःशंक कथयस्व मे ॥३-६०-१९॥
transliteration: yadi dṛṣṭā tvayā sītā jambo jāṁbūnada sama prabhā ।priyām yadi vijānāsi niḥśaṁka kathayasva me ॥3-60-19॥

translations.english: O Jambu tree, do not hesitate to tell me if you know Sita whose body shines lovely like gold.
